Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related, or business field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 1–2 years of experience coordinating clinical research trials within an academic medical center or healthcare environment.
Prior experience managing Phase 1 or complex inpatient clinical trials.
Hands-on experience working with OnCore or equivalent Clinical Trial Management Systems.
Duties include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate screening, pre-screening, consent assistance, and visit scheduling for patients across assigned clinical trial protocols.
Abstract clinical data from electronic medical records (EMR), research charts, and source documents accurately.
Input study data into electronic databases, EMR, and the institutional Clinical Trial Management System (OnCore).
Communicate across multidisciplinary teams—including principal investigators, clinical nurses, sponsors, and research staff—to maintain protocol compliance and logistical support.
Proficient with electronic medical record systems and familiarity with electronic data capture (EDC) platforms.
Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines, FDA regulations, and institutional IRB procedures.
Strong organizational, administrative, and interpersonal skills to manage multiple study protocols and patient schedules efficiently.
